name: Safa Line
summary: One continuous architectural contour joins a centered dome, twin minarets, and an open doorway.
why: The outline follows the exterior of one connected mosque. Mirrored towers share a baseline and meet the hall through quiet side wings. Matching curve and line weights keep the gold caps part of the same contour.
risk: The line drawing is lighter than a filled mark, especially at very small sizes.
sub1: A complete mosque with room to breathe
sub2: Quiet symmetry and clear Islamic identity
reasonToChoose: You want an airy architectural mark with understated symmetry.
